note: Bytes that legitimately vary between runs. Keyed by paged command and address ("*" for any address without an exact entry). ranges are [start, end) byte offsets, end null = to the end (or to the stride). stride repeats the ranges every N bytes. platform limits an entry to one platform. sections limits it to baseline, state_a, writes, state_b or restore (the initial read against the restored state); without it the entry applies everywhere.
